diagnosis_basis: 2026-10-19 independent diagnosis of v19-v23: (a) CosineAnnealingLR(T_max=20) never completes because every recorded run stops or peaks within epochs 1-11, so the effective schedule is an unplanned high-LR plateau; (b) one seed and a pretrain/no-pretrain confound make 'pretraining value' unproven; (c) the correction-vs-residual slope of v21 was 0.48-0.63, i.e. single-run variance is a larger problem than bias.
model_architecture: models.PowerAnchoredTimeDART.Model, byte-identical to v21; no model, loss, feature, scaler, label, optimizer-group, learning-rate, weight-decay, gradient-clip or selection-rule change
pretrain_scope: Same-fold seed-2024 pretrain checkpoint of the completed v20 reference, SHA-pinned in the v21 recipe. Seeds 2025 and 2026 vary the fine-tuning stage only; pretraining variance is not measured.

PretrainedOriginal.role: reference: exact v21 recipe, now with three seeds

PretrainedMatched.role: primary candidate: cosine horizon matched to the observed run length

ScratchMatched.role: pretraining control: identical to PretrainedMatched except no transferred weights

matched_epochs_rationale: 8 is the median of the three v21 completed run lengths (8, 8, 6 epochs); declared before any v24 run, never tuned. Patience stays 5 and the selection rule is unchanged.
dlinear_reference_dir_source: reference_dir of the v21 recipe (completed v20 suite); only seed 2024 exists there
inner_epoch_selection: Original-scale MAE on the chronological internal selection block, epoch 0 (Persistence-equivalent) included, strict improvement only.
readout: Per-arm seed mean of the three single-seed forecasts is reported as a secondary estimator. The gate uses single-seed means, which is the conservative reading.

outer_gate.scope: Chronological internal selection only; no outer predictions before the gate
outer_gate.seed_aggregation: per-fold mean of the three single-seed metrics
outer_gate.if_failed: Complete the training-only factorial with no outer evaluation and retain the negative result
outer_gate.if_passed: Evaluate the exact PretrainedMatched seeds and their seed mean in all three folds, including any internally harmed fold, with no outer-based fallback

reproducibility_check: PretrainedOriginal seed 2024 repeats the completed v21 candidate. The maximum absolute inner MAE/RMSE difference is reported, not gated.
claim_scope: Falsifiable training-recipe and pretraining-value test on a single wind farm and the same recipes already inspected on the outer validation block. A pass is a candidate for independent confirmation, not a final model. No appended epochs, seeds, thresholds or hyperparameter search.
